entries.en: Moving these boxes will free up some storage space.
entries.zh: 搬走这些箱子就能腾出一些储物空间。

entries.en: The lake may freeze over before the weekend.
entries.zh: 这个湖可能会在周末之前结冰。

entries.en: These narrow pipes tend to freeze up in winter.
entries.zh: 这些细管在冬天容易冻住。

entries.en: The laboratory freeze-dried the samples before storing them.
entries.zh: 实验室将样品冻干后再保存。

entries.en: You can freeze-frame the video to examine each movement.
entries.zh: 你可以把视频定格，仔细查看每一个动作。

entries.en: Her working hours vary from day to day.
entries.zh: 她的工作时间每天都不一样。

entries.en: We knew the project was risky from the word go.
entries.zh: 我们从一开始就知道这个项目有风险。

entries.en: The pond froze during the cold night.
entries.zh: 池塘在那个寒冷的夜晚结了冰。

entries.en: I will fry up some potatoes for lunch.
entries.zh: 我午饭要煎些土豆。

entries.en: Stop fucking about and finish the report.
entries.zh: 别他妈瞎折腾了，把报告写完。

entries.en: Do not fuck around with the safety switch.
entries.zh: 别他妈乱摆弄安全开关。

entries.en: The children ran full tilt towards the playground.
entries.zh: 孩子们全速向操场跑去。

entries.en: We are fund-raising to repair the village hall.
entries.zh: 我们正在筹款修缮村里的礼堂。

entries.en: Hard water can make your kettle fur up.
entries.zh: 硬水会使水壶结垢。

entries.en: The cyclist began to gain on the leading group.
entries.zh: 这位自行车选手开始追近领先的小组。

entries.en: We asked for an extension to gain time.
entries.zh: 我们申请延期，以争取时间。

entries.en: It is unfair to gang up on one classmate.
entries.zh: 联合起来对付一个同学是不公平的。

entries.en: He gave the spare key to his neighbour.
entries.zh: 他把备用钥匙给了邻居。

entries.en: Generally speaking, these plants prefer a sunny position.
entries.zh: 一般而言，这些植物喜欢阳光充足的位置。

entries.en: We must get a move on or miss the train.
entries.zh: 我们必须抓紧，否则就赶不上火车了。

entries.en: I need to get away from the office briefly.
entries.zh: 我需要暂时离开办公室。

entries.en: You cannot get away with copying another student's work.
entries.zh: 你不能抄袭其他学生的作业却不受惩罚。

entries.en: She wanted to get back at him for lying.
entries.zh: 她想因为他说谎而报复他。

entries.en: Let us get back to the original question.
entries.zh: 我们回到最初的问题吧。

entries.en: It is time to get down to planning.
entries.zh: 该开始认真制定计划了。

entries.en: Let us get down to brass tacks and discuss costs.
entries.zh: 我们来谈实质问题，讨论一下成本吧。

entries.en: Trying to get even with him will solve nothing.
entries.zh: 想报复他解决不了任何问题。

entries.en: They plan to get hitched after graduation.
entries.zh: 他们打算毕业后结婚。

entries.en: Can small businesses get in on the new project?
entries.zh: 小企业能参与这个新项目吗？

entries.en: Other shops soon tried to get in on the act.
entries.zh: 其他商店很快也想参与进来。

entries.en: Try to get into the habit of saving regularly.
entries.zh: 试着养成定期储蓄的习惯。

entries.en: Take a map so you do not get lost.
entries.zh: 带上地图，免得迷路。

entries.term: get off to a good start
entries.en: A clear agenda helps meetings get off to a good start.
entries.zh: 明确的议程有助于会议顺利开始。

entries.en: We need to get out of this difficult situation.
entries.zh: 我们需要摆脱这个困境。

entries.en: She knows how to get round her strict father.
entries.zh: 她知道怎样说服严格的父亲。

entries.en: I hope to get round to painting the fence.
entries.zh: 我希望能抽出时间给篱笆刷漆。

entries.en: Small insects can get stuck in the sticky resin.
entries.zh: 小昆虫可能会被卡在黏稠的树脂里。

entries.en: Who would like to get the ball rolling?
entries.zh: 谁愿意先开个头？

entries.en: Poor performers sometimes get the bird from this audience.
entries.zh: 表演不佳的人有时会遭到这群观众的嘘声。

entries.en: Workers feared they would get the boot without warning.
entries.zh: 工人们担心自己会毫无预警地被解雇。

entries.en: Several managers may get the chop after the merger.
entries.zh: 合并后，几位经理可能会被解雇。

entries.en: You will soon get the hang of this camera.
entries.zh: 你很快就会掌握这台相机的使用窍门。

entries.en: We left early to get the jump on our rivals.
entries.zh: 我们早早出发，想抢在竞争对手前面行动。

entries.en: He worried he would get the push next.
entries.zh: 他担心下一个被解雇的就是自己。

entries.en: I could not get through to the clinic.
entries.zh: 我没能打通诊所的电话。

entries.en: I would like to get to know my neighbours.
entries.zh: 我想逐渐了解我的邻居们。

entries.en: The noise made it hard to get to sleep.
entries.zh: 噪声让人难以入睡。

entries.en: We must get to the bottom of this error.
entries.zh: 我们必须查清这个错误的根源。

entries.en: What did you get up to during the holidays?
entries.zh: 你假期里都做了些什么？

entries.en: It takes time to get used to night work.
entries.zh: 习惯夜班需要时间。

entries.en: The press may get wind of the negotiations.
entries.zh: 媒体可能会得到有关谈判的消息。

entries.en: Customers soon get wise to misleading advertisements.
entries.zh: 顾客很快就会识破误导性的广告。

entries.en: She was hired to ghost-write the athlete's autobiography.
entries.zh: 她受雇为这位运动员代写自传。

entries.meaningZh: 用礼品纸包装，gift-wrap 的过去式
entries.en: The assistant gift-wrapped the book in silver paper.
entries.zh: 店员用银色礼品纸包好了那本书。

entries.en: The discussions may give birth to a new partnership.
entries.zh: 这些讨论可能会促成新的合作关系。

entries.en: Two witnesses agreed to give evidence in court.
entries.zh: 两名证人同意出庭作证。

entries.en: Please give me the smaller of those two boxes.
entries.zh: 请把那两个箱子中较小的那个给我。

entries.en: Give over arguing and help me move this table.
entries.zh: 别争了，帮我搬这张桌子。

entries.en: We must give priority to repairs affecting safety.
entries.zh: 我们必须优先考虑涉及安全的维修。

entries.en: I will give Maya a ring after lunch.
entries.zh: 我午饭后会给玛雅打电话。

entries.meaningZh: 不再相信，对……不再抱希望
entries.en: Please do not give up on this promising student.
entries.zh: 请不要对这个有潜力的学生失去信心。

entries.en: He began to give vent to his frustration.
entries.zh: 他开始发泄自己的沮丧情绪。

entries.en: The meeting allowed residents to give voice to their concerns.
entries.zh: 这次会议让居民能表达自己的担忧。

entries.en: The laughter began to give way to silence.
entries.zh: 笑声开始被沉默取代。

entries.en: The ball may glance off the wall.
entries.zh: 球可能会擦过墙面弹开。

entries.en: They plan to globetrot after they retire.
entries.zh: 他们计划退休后周游世界。

entries.en: I cannot go along with that decision.
entries.zh: 我不能同意那个决定。

entries.en: You go at every task with remarkable energy.
entries.zh: 你做每项任务都格外有干劲。

entries.en: We will go back to the village tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我们明天会回到村子。

entries.en: A short introduction should go before the main argument.
entries.zh: 主体论证之前应有一段简短介绍。

entries.en: Several children may go down with flu.
entries.zh: 几个孩子可能会患上流感。

entries.en: Please go easy on the salt tonight.
entries.zh: 今晚请少放一点盐。

entries.en: A loose cable could make someone go flying.
entries.zh: 一根松散的电缆可能会把人绊倒。

entries.en: Nobody in this village should have to go hungry.
entries.zh: 这个村里不该有人挨饿。

entries.en: Will you go in for the swimming competition?
entries.zh: 你会参加游泳比赛吗？

entries.en: She decided to go it alone and open a bakery.
entries.zh: 她决定单干，开一家面包店。

entries.en: Do not let anyone go off with your suitcase.
entries.zh: 别让任何人拿走你的手提箱。

entries.en: We can go on to discuss the second proposal.
entries.zh: 我们可以接着讨论第二项提议。

entries.en: Our rivals built a pool; we will go one better.
entries.zh: 我们的对手建了游泳池，我们要更胜一筹。

entries.en: Several students will go out for the scholarship.
entries.zh: 几名学生将争取这项奖学金。

entries.en: Please go out of the side door quietly.
entries.zh: 请安静地从侧门出去。

entries.en: Rumours tend to go round this small town quickly.
entries.zh: 传言往往会在这个小镇迅速流传。

entries.en: No child should go short of warm clothing.
entries.zh: 任何孩子都不应缺少保暖衣物。

entries.en: We decided to go the whole hog and renovate everything.
entries.zh: 我们决定干到底，把所有地方都翻新。

entries.en: She could not go through with the sale.
entries.zh: 她无法坚持完成这笔交易。

entries.en: The union will go to bat for its members.
entries.zh: 工会会为其成员据理力争。

entries.en: We may have to go to court over this dispute.
entries.zh: 我们可能不得不为这场纠纷打官司。

entries.en: They threatened to go to law over the boundary.
entries.zh: 他们威胁要为边界问题打官司。

entries.en: Do not let the lettuce go to seed.
entries.zh: 不要让生菜抽薹结籽。

entries.en: We need not go to the expense of hiring a van.
entries.zh: 我们不必花钱租一辆货车。

entries.en: For once, relax and go with the flow.
entries.zh: 这一次放松点，顺其自然吧。

entries.en: There is no milk, so we must go without.
entries.zh: 没有牛奶了，我们只好将就着不用。

entries.en: Something unusual is going on outside the station.
entries.zh: 车站外正发生着不寻常的事。

entries.meaningZh: 仍然活跃，仍在正常运转
entries.en: Our old refrigerator is still going strong.
entries.zh: 我们的旧冰箱仍然运转良好。

entries.en: The boys wanted to goof around after lunch.
entries.zh: 男孩们午饭后想随便玩闹一阵。

entries.en: Do not goof off while your colleagues are working.
entries.zh: 同事们工作时，不要偷懒。

entries.en: The soldiers began to goose-step across the square.
entries.zh: 士兵们开始踢着正步穿过广场。

entries.en: I gotta leave before the last bus.
entries.zh: 我得在末班车开走前离开。

entries.en: She has gotten several useful replies already.
entries.zh: 她已经收到了几条有用的回复。

entries.en: Granted, the room is small, but it is comfortable.
entries.zh: 诚然，房间很小，但很舒适。

entries.meaningZh: 迎难而上，处理棘手问题
entries.en: We must grasp the nettle and discuss the debt.
entries.zh: 我们必须迎难而上，讨论债务问题。

entries.en: Her thoughtful reply gratified the worried parents.
entries.zh: 她体贴周到的答复让忧心的父母感到满意。

entries.en: The young tree grew rapidly during the summer.
entries.zh: 那棵小树在夏季长得很快。

entries.en: We had to grin and bear it until help arrived.
entries.zh: 我们不得不默默忍受，直到救援到来。

entries.en: The armoured vehicles continued to grind on through the mud.
entries.zh: 装甲车辆继续在泥地里缓慢而坚定地前进。

entries.en: Teenagers sometimes grow away from their childhood friends.
entries.zh: 青少年有时会逐渐与童年的朋友疏远。

entries.en: This seedling could grow into a magnificent oak.
entries.zh: 这株幼苗有可能长成一棵壮丽的橡树。

entries.en: The new design will grow on you eventually.
entries.zh: 你最终会逐渐喜欢上这个新设计。

entries.en: Your hair will grow out in a few months.
entries.zh: 再过几个月，你的头发就会长长。

entries.en: Children quickly grow out of their first shoes.
entries.zh: 孩子们很快就长得穿不下最初的鞋子了。

entries.en: Regular checks help guard against equipment failure.
entries.zh: 定期检查有助于预防设备故障。

entries.en: Do not gulp down your food so quickly.
entries.zh: 不要那么快地狼吞虎咽。

entries.en: His rivals will gun for him after this mistake.
entries.zh: 出了这个错误后，他的对手会伺机攻击他。

entries.en: We will gussy up the hall with ribbons.
entries.zh: 我们要用彩带把礼堂装饰得漂漂亮亮。

entries.meaningZh: 毁坏……内部，gut 的过去式
entries.en: The fire gutted the old cinema overnight.
entries.zh: 大火一夜之间烧毁了老电影院的内部。

entries.en: The injured animal was haemorrhaging when the vet arrived.
entries.zh: 兽医到达时，那只受伤的动物正在大出血。

entries.en: Please hand back the keys before you leave.
entries.zh: 离开前请把钥匙交还。

entries.en: You must hand in the form by Friday.
entries.zh: 你必须在星期五之前交表。

entries.en: We should hand on these skills to younger workers.
entries.zh: 我们应该把这些技能传授给年轻工人。

entries.en: We cannot hang about here all afternoon.
entries.zh: 我们不能整个下午都在这里闲待着。

entries.en: The committee will hang fire until the results arrive.
entries.zh: 委员会会暂缓行动，直到结果出来。

entries.en: Hang in there; the rescue team is nearly here.
entries.zh: 坚持住，救援队快到了。

entries.en: Hang on to the rail when the boat moves.
entries.zh: 船开动时，要紧紧抓住栏杆。

entries.en: Teenagers often hang round the shops after school.
entries.zh: 青少年放学后常在商店附近闲逛。

entries.en: The mill stood hard by, beyond a low stone wall.
entries.zh: 磨坊就在附近，在一道矮石墙的另一边。

entries.en: These ceremonies hark back to a much older tradition.
entries.zh: 这些仪式可以追溯到更古老的传统。

entries.en: Did you have a hand in designing this garden?
entries.zh: 你参与设计这个花园了吗？

entries.en: You seem to have a temperature this morning.
entries.zh: 你今天早上似乎发烧了。

entries.en: I have a thing about spiders and avoid them.
entries.zh: 我特别怕蜘蛛，总是避开它们。

entries.en: These leaking boots have had it at last.
entries.zh: 这双漏水的靴子终于彻底不能穿了。

entries.en: We should have it out before resentment grows.
entries.zh: 我们应该在怨气加深之前把话说清楚。

entries.en: I have mixed feelings about leaving this town.
entries.zh: 对于离开这座小镇，我心情很复杂。

entries.en: We have no intention of selling the house.
entries.zh: 我们不打算出售这所房子。

entries.en: I have no stomach for another lengthy argument.
entries.zh: 我不愿再进行一场漫长的争论。

entries.en: I have no time for people who bully others.
entries.zh: 我讨厌欺凌他人的人。

entries.en: You have only to ask for help.
entries.zh: 你只需要开口求助就行了。

entries.en: Our critics may find that we have the last laugh.
entries.zh: 批评我们的人可能会发现，笑到最后的是我们。

entries.en: He slid head-first into the narrow tunnel.
entries.zh: 他头朝前滑进了狭窄的隧道。

entries.en: The cut should heal up in a few days.
entries.zh: 伤口应该几天内就能愈合。

entries.en: The captain ordered the crew to heave to.
entries.zh: 船长命令船员让船顶风停航。

entries.en: The yacht began to heel over in the wind.
entries.zh: 游艇开始在风中向一侧倾斜。

entries.en: We need to settle this here and now.
entries.zh: 我们需要现在就在这里解决这件事。

entries.en: The smaller boxer was ready to hit back.
entries.zh: 个头较小的拳击手准备反击。

entries.en: We might hit on a solution by comparing notes.
entries.zh: 交流想法时，我们也许会突然想到解决办法。

entries.en: He began to hit out blindly in the dark.
entries.zh: 他开始在黑暗中胡乱挥拳。

entries.en: Several councillors will hit out at the spending cuts.
entries.zh: 几位市议员将猛烈抨击削减开支的措施。

entries.en: We should hit the road before sunrise.
entries.zh: 我们应该在日出前上路。

entries.en: They may hit upon a better method during testing.
entries.zh: 他们可能会在测试期间偶然发现更好的方法。

entries.en: The startled chickens scattered hither and yon.
entries.zh: 受惊的鸡四处跑散。

entries.en: Do not hold against her a mistake she made years ago.
entries.zh: 不要因为她多年前犯的一个错误就一直对她抱有成见。

entries.en: We should hold fire until the figures are confirmed.
entries.zh: 在数字核实之前，我们应该暂缓行动。

entries.en: You should hold on to your original ambition.
entries.zh: 你应该坚持自己最初的志向。

entries.en: Hold onto my hand as we cross the road.
entries.zh: 我们过马路时，要紧紧抓住我的手。

entries.en: Please hold still while I remove the splinter.
entries.zh: 我取出这根刺时，请保持不动。

entries.en: Can you hold the fort while I fetch supplies?
entries.zh: 我去取补给品时，你能暂时代管吗？

entries.en: Shared memories help hold together a scattered family.
entries.zh: 共同的回忆有助于维系一个分散各地的家庭。

entries.en: I do not hold with punishing children for accidents.
entries.zh: 我不赞成因孩子无意造成的事故而惩罚他们。

entries.en: Hop it before I call the caretaker.
entries.zh: 赶紧走开，不然我要叫管理员了。

entries.en: We can only wait and hope for the best.
entries.zh: 我们只能等待，并抱最好的希望。

entries.en: We had to hot-foot it to the station.
entries.zh: 我们不得不急匆匆地赶到车站。

entries.en: She hung the wet towels beside the fire.
entries.zh: 她把湿毛巾挂在炉火旁。

entries.en: I will hunt out the old photographs tonight.
entries.zh: 我今晚会把那些老照片找出来。

entries.en: We had to hurry along to catch the others.
entries.zh: 我们不得不匆忙赶路，好追上其他人。

entries.en: Please hurry up; the taxi is waiting.
entries.zh: 请快一点，出租车在等着。

entries.en: We used to ice-skate on the frozen pond.
entries.zh: 我们过去常在结冰的池塘上滑冰。

entries.en: Do not idle away the entire morning online.
entries.zh: 不要在网上虚度整个上午。

entries.en: If anything, the weather has become even colder.
entries.zh: 如果说有什么变化的话，天气变得更冷了。

entries.en: We can work late if need be.
entries.zh: 如果有需要，我们可以工作到很晚。

entries.en: We can eat in the garden, if you like.
entries.zh: 如果你愿意，我们可以在花园里吃饭。

entries.en: The room is spacious; in addition, it has a balcony.
entries.zh: 这个房间很宽敞，另外还带有阳台。

entries.en: We cannot accept bribery in any shape or form.
entries.zh: 我们不能接受任何形式的贿赂。

entries.en: I cannot in conscience recommend this unsafe machine.
entries.zh: 凭良心说，我不能推荐这台不安全的机器。

entries.en: The remark was made in fun, not anger.
entries.zh: 这番话是开玩笑说的，不是气话。

entries.en: Please read the agreement in its entirety.
entries.zh: 请完整地阅读这份协议。

entries.en: She worked Sunday and took Monday off in lieu.
entries.zh: 她星期天工作，改在星期一补休。

entries.en: The delay was in part caused by bad weather.
entries.zh: 延误部分是由恶劣天气造成的。

entries.en: In that case, we should postpone the meeting.
entries.zh: 如果是那样，我们应该推迟会议。

entries.en: We design and print all our leaflets in-house.
entries.zh: 我们所有传单都在内部设计和印刷。

entries.en: Inch by inch, the boat moved through the reeds.
entries.zh: 船一点一点地穿过芦苇丛。

entries.en: My grandmother often asks me to inquire after you.
entries.zh: 我祖母常让我问候你。

entries.en: Our team uses instant messaging for quick questions.
entries.zh: 我们的团队用即时通信来询问简短的问题。

entries.en: She plans to jack in her job next month.
entries.zh: 她打算下个月辞去工作。

entries.en: Sudden braking can make a lorry jack-knife.
entries.zh: 突然刹车可能使卡车折弯失控。

entries.en: Do not jerk around the people trying to help.
entries.zh: 不要耍弄那些想要帮忙的人。

entries.en: Everyone is welcome to join in the game.
entries.zh: 欢迎每个人加入这个游戏。

entries.en: He decided to join up after leaving school.
entries.zh: 他离校后决定参军。

entries.en: Feel free to jump in with your suggestions.
entries.zh: 你可以随时加入讨论，提出建议。

entries.term: jump in at the deep end
entries.meaningZh: 在缺乏经验时面对艰巨任务
entries.en: New recruits often jump in at the deep end here.
entries.zh: 在这里，新人常常一开始就要面对艰巨的任务。

entries.en: Do not jump the gun and announce unconfirmed results.
entries.zh: 不要过早行动，宣布尚未确认的结果。
